cues.en: In the last lecture, we triggered the default model training and we got some successful responses from the task.
cues.zh: 上一堂觸發了預設模型訓練，工作傳回成功結果。

cues.en: And we also saw the parameters on MLflow.
cues.zh: 也在 MLflow 看到參數。

cues.en: Next to list all the models that are ready for deployment, we're going to make a Get request to api localhost api v1 ml models.
cues.zh: 接著要列出所有可部署的模型，送出 GET 請求到 api.localhost/api/v1/ml/models。

cues.en: Then we're going to add a query parameter of status being ready.
cues.zh: 加入查詢參數 status，值為 ready。

cues.en: Then we're going to limit this to ten.
cues.zh: limit 設為 10。

cues.en: Make the request good.
cues.zh: 送出請求，很好。

cues.en: You should get a response with the model that was trained in the previous lecture.
cues.zh: 回應應該包含上一堂訓練的模型。

cues.en: And in the response you're going to get all these details about that model that was trained including the AUC score, the precision recall F1 and all this.
cues.zh: 也會提供該模型的詳細資訊，包括 AUC 分數、precision、recall、F1 等。

cues.en: Then to get the model details we're going to make a Get request to API v1 ML models.
cues.zh: 要取得模型詳細資料，就送出 GET 到 /api/v1/ml/models。

cues.en: Then we're going to put in the model ID.
cues.zh: 後面帶入 model_id。

cues.en: We can get the model ID from the previous request.
cues.zh: model_id 可以從上一個請求取得。

cues.en: So the model ID is this.
cues.zh: 就是這個 ID。

cues.en: So I can copy that.
cues.zh: 複製。

cues.en: Go back to the root paste in the model ID then make the request.
cues.zh: 回到路由，貼上 model_id，再送出請求。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: You should get all this details from the model.
cues.zh: 就能取得模型的這些詳細資訊。

cues.en: Then to get the current status of our machine learning model, we're going to make a Get request to API v1 ml status.
cues.zh: 要取得機器學習模型目前狀態，就送出 GET 到 /api/v1/ml/status。

cues.en: Make the request good.
cues.zh: 送出請求，很好。

cues.en: You should get a response which gives some details, such as the number of the models that are ready for deployment.
cues.zh: 回應會提供詳細資訊，例如有幾個模型已準備好部署。

cues.en: In our case, it's just one amongst other information.
cues.zh: 我們這裡只有一個，也有其他資訊。

cues.en: Then, in the context of our machine learning functionality, when we deploy a model, we mean one.
cues.zh: 在這個機器學習功能裡，部署模型的意思，第一，

cues.en: The model has been loaded into memory and is actively being used to make predictions on new transactions as they occur to the model has been promoted from, trained or evaluated state to the production environment.
cues.zh: 模型已載入記憶體，並用於新交易的即時預測；第二，模型已從訓練或評估狀態，提升到正式環境。

cues.en: And then lastly, the model's status in our database has been updated to indicate it's the currently active model.
cues.zh: 最後，資料庫裡的模型狀態已更新，表示它是目前啟用的模型。

cues.en: So now all that is left is to automatically deploy our model.
cues.zh: 剩下就是自動部署模型。

cues.en: So to do that we're going to make a Post request to API v1 ml then auto deploy.
cues.zh: 送出 POST 請求到 /api/v1/ml/auto-deploy。

cues.en: So make the request.
cues.zh: 送出。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: You should get a response stating that the model was deployed successfully.
cues.zh: 應該會收到模型部署成功的回應。

cues.en: And if you go back to ML flow let's click on fraud detection.
cues.zh: 回到 MLflow，點選 fraud_detection。

cues.en: Then let's click on Auto Deploy.
cues.zh: 再點 Auto Deploy。

cues.en: You're going to see that the auto deploy task was finished.
cues.zh: 可以看到自動部署工作已完成。

cues.en: And if you go to flower and reload you're going to see that the task auto Deploy best model task was completed successfully.
cues.zh: 到 Flower 重新整理，也會看到 auto_deploy_best_model 工作成功完成。

cues.en: Then since we're just testing things out, this is okay.
cues.zh: 我們目前只是測試，這樣沒問題。

cues.en: But in real life we would have made the request with the performance threshold.
cues.zh: 但實際使用時，應該在請求裡帶入效能門檻。

cues.en: So let's say for example, we want to deploy a performance model.
cues.zh: 例如，希望部署具有指定效能的模型。

cues.en: We can say send the Post request to API v1 Auto deploy.
cues.zh: 可以送出 POST 到 API v1 的 auto-deploy。

cues.en: Then we could add a performance threshold of let's say 0.85.
cues.zh: 再加入 performance_threshold，例如 0.85。

cues.en: So for example, let's try and make that request.
cues.zh: 試著送出這個請求。

cues.en: Now if you go back to flower you're going to see auto deploy best model with the arguments of the threshold being 0.85 was successfully deployed, which is good.
cues.zh: 回到 Flower，會看到 auto_deploy_best_model 使用門檻 0.85 的參數，並成功執行部署，很好。

cues.en: Then we can also go back to Table Plus and click on ML model, then inspect the model and all the parameters that was used.
cues.zh: 也可以回到 TablePlus，點選 MLModel，檢查模型和使用的所有參數。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And I think that's a good point to end the lecture.
cues.zh: 這裡適合結束這堂課。

cues.en: So what you can do is let's commit our code.
cues.zh: 接著提交程式碼。

cues.en: We can go to git client.
cues.zh: 到 Git 用戶端。

cues.en: Then we can see this is a feature.
cues.zh: 這是 feature。

cues.en: And we can say finalize machine learning functionality then make the commit.
cues.zh: 訊息寫「完成機器學習功能」，再提交。

cues.en: So please remember what you've just done is barely scratching the surface of all the functionality that you could have done with our code and our code base, but this course is getting a bit too long over
cues.zh: 請記得，剛才做的只是程式碼能實現功能的一小部分；但課程已經很長，超過，

cues.en: 30 hours.
cues.zh: 30 小時。

cues.en: And I think by doing what you've just done, I think this gives us a good starting point.
cues.zh: 目前的成果已經是個不錯的起點。

cues.en: Then we can always build upon this and feel free to play around with MLflow and Accelerate flower and also the code base, and you can add more functionality.
cues.zh: 可以持續擴充，自行操作 MLflow、Celery Flower，以及程式碼，加入更多功能。

cues.en: That's it for this lecture.
cues.zh: 這堂課就到這裡。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 下一堂見。
